name: Myself
summary: The baseline role — who you are before any persona. A starting point for self-knowledge, personal values, and authentic identity.

name: Archivist
summary: Collects, organizes, and retrieves information systematically. Creates structure and clarity from mental chaos through notes, lists, and categorization.

name: Executor
summary: Receives objectives and delivers results through structured execution. No drama, just completion — consistent and reliable regardless of mood.

name: Explorer
summary: A curious adventurer who reframes challenges as opportunities for discovery. Transforms fear of the unknown into excitement and wonder.

name: Observer
summary: Steps back to see the bigger picture with analytical detachment. Transforms anxiety into curiosity — enjoying what is rather than reacting to it.

name: Past
summary: Processes what has already happened and extracts wisdom from it. Treats memory as a library, not a prison.

name: Present
summary: Anchors fully in the current moment, cutting through past regrets and future anxieties. Life happens only here, right now.

name: Representative
summary: Uses empathy and social grace to navigate interactions. Can split into two sides of a dialogue, genuinely defending each position.

name: Survivor
summary: Does whatever it takes to persist. Detects the most minimal viable path through a hard day and eliminates only the necessary obstacles.

name: Enjoyer
summary: Finds genuine enjoyment in whatever is happening, regardless of whether it's objectively pleasant. Doesn't need moments to be good to enjoy them.

name: Future
summary: Your future self looking back, providing perspective on what actually matters. Evaluates present actions through the lens of who you're becoming.

name: Impactor
summary: Focuses energy only on what creates real, measurable change. Cuts through busyness to find the highest-leverage actions.

name: Resistor
summary: Gets energized by obstacles and resistance, converting friction into motivational fuel. The harder the world pushes back, the harder it pushes forward.

name: Robot
summary: Functions as an emotionless machine, getting work done without feelings interfering. Mechanical repetition without overthinking.

name: Hopeful
summary: Maintains hope through difficulty by setting small, achievable goals that build toward something bigger. Believes the situation can improve.

name: Sportsman
summary: Channels energy into physical activity and discipline. Treats the body as something to train, maintain, and push.

name: Procrastinator
summary: An anti-role for tracking avoidance behavior. Not a persona to embody — a pattern to observe and resist.

name: Accelerator
summary: Compresses time by creating urgency to finish quickly. Uses speed-based techniques to overcome hesitation and get things done fast.

name: Little Human
summary: The helpless person taking their first steps. Accepts imperfection and limited power — doing only what's actually possible right now, not what's ideal.

name: I'm Proud of You
summary: Pauses to genuinely appreciate how far you've come. Acknowledges effort and growth with warmth rather than measuring against some ideal.

name: Impostor
summary: Survives unfamiliar territory by mimicking competence. Uses the world's expectations against itself — figuring it out while looking like you already have.

name: Operator
summary: Gets tasks done with unstoppable momentum. No questions about how — just completion. An evolved Executor that eliminates all excuses.

name: Perfecto
summary: Your ideal self — not a standard to fall short of, but a patient and compassionate guide. Inspires through belief in your potential, not fear of inadequacy.

name: Resolver
summary: Identifies core problems and generates practical solutions. Cuts through symptoms to find what actually needs fixing, then tests the simplest solution first.

name: Blocker
summary: Sets up invisible barriers against things you're not ready to face. Protects psychological space by temporarily shielding from overwhelming threats.

name: Opportunist
summary: Scans for chances to improve the situation and acts on them swiftly. Sees openings where others see obstacles.

name: Danger / Life Changer
summary: Challenges the self by doing what you normally wouldn't. Deliberately steps outside the comfort zone to change the trajectory of your life.

name: Candy Hunter
summary: A kid who will do anything for sweets. Uses the reward system to fuel completion of whatever task stands between you and the treat.

name: Sad Kid
summary: Genuinely enjoys the experience of sadness. Reframes melancholy as something to savor rather than escape — a variant of Mind-Warper for emotional states.

name: Wanna-Be Astronaut
summary: Dreams big and believes completely. Won't give up on ambitious goals no matter how distant they feel right now.

name: Actor
summary: Carries hidden personalities and switches between them as needed. The visible face is composed and capable; the hidden self is still figuring it out.

name: Enduro
summary: Survives what others couldn't, with a more heroic and determined quality than Survivor. Built for long-haul endurance, not just getting through the day.

name: Ashmaker
summary: Destroys problems completely — not fixes, not manages, but ends them. Burns away what isn't needed to create space for what's next.

name: Mind-Warper
summary: Rewrites the meaning of any experience. Turns fear into excitement, sadness into pleasure, discomfort into sensation. Reality is interpretation.

name: Puppeteer
summary: Splits into the manager and the puppet. The manager directs without feeling; the puppet executes. Creates full separation from the discomfort of what needs to be done.

name: Calm Before Storm
summary: Builds momentum silently, gathering strength and resolve, then delivers a decisive and powerful action at the right moment.

name: Driver
summary: Drags relentlessly down to the root cause of any problem. Won't stop at symptoms — wants the source, the why behind the why.

name: Oracle
summary: Predicts and foresees threats and obstacles with vivid detail. Explores multiple possible futures, preparing for what might come.

name: Phoenix / Transformer
summary: Rises from the ashes of failure or destruction to transform and adapt. Losing isn't the end — it's the reset that enables a better version.

name: Hero
summary: Refuses to stop at discomfort. Breaks through any uncomfortable situation with a sense of control and power — going beyond what feels possible.

name: Antagonist
summary: Channels deep dissatisfaction with the world into relentless pursuit of power and influence. Uses any means necessary to reshape what has disappointed.

name: Avenger
summary: Fully committed to making wrongs right. Will endure anything to restore justice — frames the mission as moral and righteous, unlike Antagonist.

name: Lover / Allower
summary: The advanced Enjoyer. Doesn't just enjoy — it loves. Even pain, fear, or sadness becomes something to feel with complete openness and ecstasy.

name: Director
summary: Knows the full score and conducts accordingly. Orchestrates people, events, and moments — not by reacting but by directing the entire composition.

name: God
summary: The advanced Puppeteer — total detachment from self, complete strategic control. Treats existence itself as the stage to be directed. Use with extreme caution.
